subject: Banking
title: Student Loan Servicing Abuses
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Student Loan Servicing Abuses.

hook.text: Navient steered 60% of borrowers into forbearance instead of income-driven repayment plans.

buildup.text: Student loan servicers earn fees per account. Processing forbearance takes 2 minutes. Processing IDR takes 30 minutes.

discovery.text: Navient's practices added billions in extra interest to borrowers' balances.

twist.text: Navient settled for $1.85 billion in relief. It denied wrongdoing but agreed to cancel $1.7 billion in student loans.

climax.text: Student loan servicing shows misaligned incentives. When servicers profit from borrower confusion.

punchline.text: 2 minutes for the expensive option. 30 for the helpful one.

quiz.question: Why did Navient steer borrowers into forbearance?
options: Processing took 2 minutes vs 30 for cheaper repayment plans
